fieldOverrides.//: pollImportJobs scans every user's jobs with a collectionGroup query. Single-field equality across a collection group is NOT covered by the automatic per-collection index — it needs this explicit override, or the query fails with FAILED_PRECONDITION. The COLLECTION-scope entries are re-declared because an override replaces a field's default indexing rather than adding to it.
autoSyncStarredPlaces and syncTakeoutFromDrive both find linked users by array-contains on the stored scope list, which needs CONTAINS at collection-group scope.
Refresh tokens are never queried on, and indexing them is needless exposure in index scans. Explicitly disable.
